asof: receipt <= instant before validation or deduplication; latest parsed receipt per key
book: Decimal; require finite 0 < yes_bid < yes_ask < 1; book:null is not empty
clocks: UTC epoch grid; venue_time.parse_venue_time; aware only

cohorts.nba: regular-season served local game date <=2026-12-20 and >=first_eligible_date

core_rules.limits: innings 1..30; periods 1..12; scores 0..1000; decimal exponent <=18, digits <=24

duplicate: identical receipts collapse; conflicting equal-receipt books refused and counted
eligibility: seal commit committer UTC date +1 day; never backdated; earlier dates development
entry: first window grid instant with valid book and state; band and admission frozen here
floor: 30 games is an admission floor, not a power guarantee

inference.method: exact Poisson-binomial DP, pure python floats
inference.verdict: n<30 INSUFFICIENT; p<0.05 and D>0 OVERPRICED_LOSER; p<0.05 and D<0 UNDERPRICED_LOSER; otherwise NO_DETECTED_DISTORTION

io: byte ticker/game_key prefilter without field-order assumptions; line-streamed; bounded temp observations for Platt and exact median; RSS ingestion/fitting checked every 10000 lines; exit 5 above 400 MiB with no receipt
late_capture: first window-state receipt >120 s after window opened; kept and counted

locks.mlb: 72 h after World Series final state receipt

looks: at lock every scheduled served game admitted/excluded by reason/unresolved; ONE immutable confirmatory receipt per sport; earlier and later receipts DESCRIPTIVE
mde_label: planning approximation: SD 0.27, 80 pct power, two-sided alpha 0.05
mirror: high-band residual=-D on identical observations; construction check only; no Prelec mirror
nba_admission: ENTRY state: type(season_type) is int, season_type==2, season_reason is None; missing, invalid and non-2 distinct exclusions
orientation: ticker suffix equals alias(home_abbr) or alias(away_abbr); else orientation_unresolved
outcome: admission before lookup; first final scores; conflicting finals or tied final unresolved

platt.refusal: separation or non-convergence unavailable, counted per fit and bootstrap replicate

population: served maker_forward schedule entries only; FOCUS snapshot only; never bulk
postseason_evidence: strict schedule season_type 3 or lead-declared postseason date roster recorded in receipt; missing evidence excluded and counted postseason_unestablished
price: ticker YES mid=(yes_bid+yes_ask)/2; complement=1-mid labelled NO_proxy
primary: D=mean(p_entry-y) over resolved band games; frozen entry low side; probability units and cents
provenance: alone introduction commit; write-once; reject rewritten, merge seal, deletion/recreation
receipt: deterministic strict JSON atomic replace; input byte sizes and head/tail sha; no time/host/path/RSS; RSS in separate .resources.json
replication: both sports confirmatory non-null verdicts same direction; otherwise SINGLE-CORPUS
report: CI endpoints and width; admitted/resolved/unresolved counts and wins; residual bounds with unresolved outcomes set to 0 and 1; conclusions resolved-only unless bounds agree

scored_mode.Q2: lead appends RESULTS_LEDGER_SYSTEM.md before receipt; family=2; K at launch
scored_mode.Q4: venue price only; no fitted arm; no walk-forward/CPCV applies
scored_mode.Q5: NBA and MLB independent corpora; never pooled; one non-null sport SINGLE-CORPUS

secondaries: Prelec exp(-(-ln(p))^0.8) on entry and path; descriptive only
shards: adjacent UTC days joined without resetting games
spread_label: abs(D)>median(entry half-spreads)+0.01: above spread; otherwise calibration finding, below spread plus fee
terminal: status live and readable gate fields required; first final receipt hard cutoff; heuristics per instant; NBA period>=4 and clock_sec==0 excluded; OT clock>0 retained
terminal_limits: MLB frozen end states at 2 outs stay; shortened or reviewed games unresolved by heuristic
terminal_rule: mlb inning >= 9 and not tied: home ahead and half Bottom -> mlb_home_ahead_bottom; home ahead and (half Middle, or Top with outs 3) -> mlb_home_ahead_after_top; away ahead and (half End, or Bottom with outs 3) -> mlb_away_ahead_after_bottom. NBA period >= 4 and clock_sec == 0 excluded at every margin; OT clock_sec > 0 kept. Both sports require live status and readable gate fields. First final receipt is a hard cutoff.
